description.p: FastProcMan is a light and fast process manager. List what is running, sort by CPU or memory, filter by name, spot suspicious processes and quit or force quit one in a click. A second tab graphs CPU, memory, network and disk activity.

description.li: Quit/Force quit can also end the process's children, so a runaway job leaves no orphans.
The slowdown warning blames the job as a whole, not one of its workers, and warns when the CPU is saturated.
The Graphs page now supports Intel GPUs, shows each core's load and has memory and swap pies.
